messages:
Mira: Hi team — completed the security learning module but I can’t view my phish sim result page. It just redirects me to the SSO error with this message: 'webauthn_required: device_not_trusted'. Anyone seen that?
Sam (People Ops): Welcome Mira! :wave: We had a recent change where the phish sim tries to validate a platform authenticator for enrolled devices. Did you register your security key or enroll your device yet?
Mira: I tried to register my YubiKey but the browser prompt for 'Add security key' never appears. I only see the Okta SSO consent page and then the error.
Raj (IT): Which browser/version? Also, did you enroll the laptop in MDM during first-boot? If the device isn't in our inventory the SSO flow skips WebAuthn provisioning.
Mira: Safari 16.3 and the loaner is a MacBook Pro (serial: C02Y9M88877). I thought Device Enrollment happened during setup but I didn't see any MDM prompts.
Raj (IT): Two quick checks: 1) run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and paste the serial, 2) run `sudo /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output. I can also look up the serial.
Mira: Serial command output: `Serial Number (system): C02Y9M88877`
Mira: `sudo /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment` returned:
```
enrollment: Not Enrolled
MDM: none
```
Mira: So that looks like it didn’t enroll.
Priya (Security): If MDM didn't enroll, our WebAuthn attestation step will be blocked by the IdP for unrecognized devices — that matches the `webauthn_required` error. We need the device in MDM before you can register a hardware key tied to your account for corporate flows.
Sam (People Ops): Sorry for the hassle — Mira, did you get the device assignment email with the provisioning ticket number? If not, Raj can re-run the imaging process.
Raj (IT): I don't see that serial in the provisioning queue. Looks like the imaging job failed at the step that posts to our MDM. I will re-run the enrollment config and push the CompanyProfile.
OnboardBot: Device assignment RD-4599 -> C02Y9M88877 recorded at 1965004380 by Raj
Raj (IT): Once I push the profile you'll get a prompt to approve MDM in System Settings and then the FileVault enablement dialog should appear. Please do NOT enable FileVault until I confirm we're escrow-ing the key to our KMS; otherwise we can't recover.
Mira: Thanks. Quick question: can I still do the training verification manually so I don’t get locked out of services?
Priya (Security): We can manually verify completion once you send a screenshot of the LMS completion page and the timestamp. We'll set your phish sim status to "pending re-run" and schedule a re-send after MDM is confirmed. If you need immediate access to an internal resource we can whitelist your Okta session for 24 hours, but only after IT confirms device identity.
Mira: Screenshot posted to the ticket — LMS shows "Complete: 2026-03-20 09:12 PDT".
Raj (IT): Pushed the profile at 1965004450. You should see an MDM management prompt in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Device Management. Approve that, then run:
```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
and then reply here when it reports enrolled.
Mira: Approved the profile and ran the command. Output: `enrollment: Enrolled (CompanyProfile v3)`
OnboardBot: PhishSim: auto-tag -> pending_rerun for user Mira at 1965004510
Priya (Security): Great — once enrollment is visible I will unlock the WebAuthn flow on Okta. Mira, try registering the YubiKey in a private window: Settings -> Security Methods -> Add security key. If it still fails, clear site data for our IdP and retry.
Mira: Registered the key successfully :tada: — WebAuthn prompt appeared and key attested.
Sam (People Ops): Yay! We'll re-run the phish sim for you next business day and clear the LMS flag if it validates. Welcome aboard Mira and congrats on getting through the onboarding chaos :smile:
Mira: Thanks everyone — huge help.
Raj (IT): Filed incident INC-2033-12 for the imaging gap so we can root-cause why some devices aren't auto-enrolling. Tagging @Sam and @Priya for follow-up.
Priya (Security): Note for audit: manual verification performed for Mira; records saved to the audit log under ticket INC-2033-12. We'll include this in next month's onboarding compliance report.
Mira: Appreciate it. I'll wait here for the re-run and keep my YubiKey handy.
